title: Ball Knowledge Greybox Tunables
description: Phase 2 greybox tunables. PROCESS RULE (world-design.md §10): every value must carry a _provenance entry — either a doc citation (locked; do not tune without a design session) or TUNE (placeholder; propose a default, feel it in-game, Phil signs off) or SCAFFOLD (mechanism present but missing its designed gate) or verified: (derived by verification, not design). tools/validate_greybox.py enforces completeness in both directions.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v2 (2026-07-17): provenance markers mandatory; flee roll and 4s chase-break removed per world-design.md §4.1.2; fine/bribe formula per §4.1.1; speeds per §2.2.2.

_provenance.description: Authority marker per value, keyed by dotted path (group.key). Prefixes — 'wd:§x' = docs/world-design.md section (LOCKED); 'p2:x' = docs/phase2-greybox.md section (LOCKED); 'TUNE' = open placeholder; 'SCAFFOLD <citation>' = present but missing the designed gate the citation names; 'verified:<date>' = derived by verification. Unmarked scaffolding becomes the design — that is what this map exists to prevent.

player.description: First-person movement and look tuning values for the greybox slice.

walk_speed_ms.description: Player walking speed in meters per second. wd:§2.2.2 locks 2.5 — game speed, not real human 1.4 m/s (at real speed the map diagonal costs 41% of a 20-minute day).

run_speed_ms.description: Player sprint speed in meters per second. wd:§2.2.2 locks 5.0. Sprinting burns Energy (§2.2.2 sprint-energy-cash bind) — energy itself is deferred past greybox.

crouch_speed_ms.description: Player crouch speed in meters per second.

mouse_sensitivity.description: Mouse-look sensitivity multiplier for first-person camera control.

detection.description: Gang patroller vision, detection, and chase tuning. Chase model per wd:§4.1.2 — fully manual, no dice: on losing line of sight the patroller walks to the last point it saw the player and scans; search_scan_duration_s without a sighting ends the chase and returns it to patrol. Re-sighting during the scan re-acquires.

vision_half_angle_deg.description: Half-angle of the patroller vision cone in degrees.

vision_range_m.description: Maximum detection range in meters when line of sight is clear.

base_detect_time_s.description: Continuous cone+LOS time in seconds needed to detect the player at zero cash heat.

min_detect_time_s.description: Floor the detect time shrinks toward as cash heat rises.

detect_curve_exponent.description: Shape of the heat->detect-time curve: detect_time = base - (base - min) * (heat / max_heat)^exponent. 1.0 = linear (proposed GANG shape: steady pressure proportional to how hot your pockets are). CONSTRAINT (wd:§8.2): police and gang must NOT share a curve shape — two predators, two logics. The police curve (Phase 3) must be a different shape, proposed stepped/threshold.

chase_speed_mult.description: Multiplier on player run speed while the patroller is chasing.

search_scan_duration_s.description: Seconds the patroller scans at the player's last-seen point before giving up (wd:§4.1.2: ends the chase, does NOT touch any heat meter). Replaces schema v1's 4s LOS chase-break.

cash_heat.description: Gang cash-carry heat (wd:§4.2 fuel ②). Greybox carries only the cash component; the overdue-days component is deferred with the monthly debt system.

carry_threshold.description: Carrying more cash than this outdoors builds gang heat (wd:§4.2: $500; deliberately the same number as §3.1's card bootstrap).

heat_per_hour_over_threshold.description: Gang heat gained per in-game hour while carrying above the threshold outdoors (wd:§4.2: +1/hour; travel counts, camping counts as indoor).

heat_decay_per_hour_below_threshold.description: Gang heat decay per in-game hour whenever carried cash is below the threshold (wd:§4.2: -0.25/hour).

max_heat.description: Heat meter ceiling. wd:§4.1.1 prices fines against a 0-100 scale (heat 100 -> $2,000).

catch_stop.description: Gang-stop resolution. Bribe price per wd:§4.1.1: fine = heat x fine_per_heat_point; bribe = fine x bribe_fine_multiplier; CASH ONLY (wd:§3.3). Flee has NO odds and NO keys here — it is the manual chase in the detection group (wd:§4.1.2). The pay-toward-debt vig is constants.json catch_vig (0.3), which world-design never ratified — flagged back to Phil, do not treat as locked.

fine_per_heat_point.description: Dollars of fine per point of heat (wd:§4.1.1: $20; heat 100 -> $2,000).

bribe_fine_multiplier.description: bribe = fine x this (wd:§4.1.1: 2). The structure is locked; the multiplier k is feel-tunable per wd:§8.2.

bribe_always_available.description: SCAFFOLDING. wd:§6.4 gates the bribe on that officer's/collector's connection-corruptibility; NPC connections do not exist in the greybox, so the bribe is offered unconditionally. This flag exists so the gap is explicit — flip to false when the connection gate lands (Phase 3).

economy.description: Greybox economy values for the visible debt ledger and the canned Gate-2 bet.

debt_start.description: Initial on-screen debt ledger amount (wd:§3.5: $100,000 principal, confirmed 2026-07-17).

canned_bet_stake.description: Stake amount used for the deterministic canned Gate-2 bet.

canned_bet_payout.description: Winning payout amount returned by the canned Gate-2 bet (p2: ~$2,000). NOTE for Phil: the board prices this fixture at 1.29 decimal; a $1,000 stake paying $2,000 implies 2.0 — reconcile when the planning session prices Gate 2.

canned_bet_seed.description: Fixed RNG seed for the canned Gate-2 bet. Seed 8 verified 2026-07-17: Harbour FC 2-0 Eastport Rovers on BOTH the netstandard2.1 DLL + Newtonsoft pipeline (Unity's path) and the net8.0 Console.

canned_bet_outcome.description: Which 1X2 outcome the canned Gate-2 bet backs; the seed is chosen so this outcome wins.

canned_bet_home_team.description: Zero-based team index for the canned bet home team.

canned_bet_away_team.description: Zero-based team index for the canned bet away team.

real_minutes_per_game_day.description: Real minutes per full 24h in-game day (wd:§3.6: 20). One game hour = this / 24 real minutes (50 real seconds at 20).

night_start_hour.description: Hour of day when night begins, 24-hour clock.

night_end_hour.description: Hour of day when night ends, 24-hour clock.
